pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o has no place in daily life.
   C. Use : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o.

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

4. Which response best shows understanding of Schism and Syncretism in Israel? (1 mark)
   A. Say Schism and Syncretism in Israel has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Schism and Syncretism in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Schism and Syncretism in Israel to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Schism and Syncretism in Israel.

5. Which response best shows understanding of General Epistle: James? (1 mark)
   A. Say General Epistle: James has no place in daily life.
   B. Use General Epistle: James to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of General Epistle: James with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Epistle: James.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah.
   D. Apply the teaching of Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Biblical Stewardship? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Biblical Stewardship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Biblical Stewardship.
   C. Say Biblical Stewardship has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Biblical Stewardship to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of : 1Peter Selected teachings? (1 mark)
   A. Say : 1Peter Selected teachings has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of : 1Peter Selected teachings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use : 1Peter Selected teachings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing : 1Peter Selected teachings.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Prophet Hosea? (1 mark)
   A. Say Prophet Hosea has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Prophet Hosea to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Prophet Hosea with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophet Hosea.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection.
   B. Use Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection has no place in daily life.

11. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

12. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem.
   B. Say Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Biblical Stewardship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Monarchy in Israel: King David and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Schism and Syncretism in Israel and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. D — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. A — Apply the teaching of : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. D — Telling the truth and keeping trust

4. B — Apply the teaching of Schism and Syncretism in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. C — Apply the teaching of General Epistle: James with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. D — Apply the teaching of Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. A — Apply the teaching of Biblical Stewardship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. B — Apply the teaching of : 1Peter Selected teachings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. C — Apply the teaching of Prophet Hosea with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. C — Apply the teaching of Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. A — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Biblical Stewardship; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Schism and Syncretism in Israel; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
